key_facts: July 19 UPDATE (T+1d to market.csv July 20 mark / July 24 Section 122 expiration / Aug 18 criteria deadline; SUBMITTED refinement raising South Korea 0.09->0.11 and Canada 0.19->0.20, trimming United Kingdom 0.08->0.07, holding China 0.14 and France 0.12; sum=0.64): (1) Confirmed via Exa search + July 19 local news: NO Section 338 invocation yet through Sunday July 19. (4) China (0.14), France (0.12, DST), and UK (0.07, DST but warmer bilateral trade posture) round out top 5, leaving 0.36 for Brazil/India/Mexico/Japan/EU states/others.
